newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Fortis chief executive to step down.
newsitem.headline: Fortis chief executive to step down.

text.p: The Belgian financial group Fortis AG said on Wednesday that the Chief Executive of Fortis Belgium is to step down from his executive duties.
Herman Verwilst is to succeed as Chief Executive from January 1, 1997.

"Valere Croes, Chief Executive Officer Fortis Belgium, has decided to cease his executive duties with the banking, insurance and investment group Fortis and its parent companies as of the end of 1996," Fortis said in a statement.
It gave no reasons for the move.
Herman Verwilst, currently chairman of the Management Committee of ASLK-CGER Bank, will also be appointed Managing Director of Fortis AG, while Valere Croes is to remain Director of Fortis AG.
